meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research and the beui.dev interaction catalog. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, interaction, micro-interaction, make it feel alive, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计优质前端界面，整合品牌与性能标准
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要构建美观且高性能的前端界面
copy.tagline_en: Design high-quality frontend UI with brand and performance standards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build beautiful and high-performance frontend UI

howto.what: 当你处理网页或界面相关任务时，Claude 会先根据需求挑选对应的设计规范，强制先生成一个设计系统文件 DESIGN.md，再按你给的参考图或品牌风格写出可复用的组件，最后用真实浏览器检查性能和界面细节。
howto.when: 当你的任务涉及网页界面、视觉设计或改版，或提到 React、Lighthouse、无障碍等关键词时触发。

say.text: 把我的落地页改成 Stripe 那种风格
say.note: 会先提取品牌规范再改版

say.text: 给这个按钮加个平滑的悬停动效
say.note: 会参考交互目录实现动效

say.text: 用 Lighthouse 审计一下首页性能，给修复建议
say.note: 会用真实浏览器跑审计并给报告

howto.what_en: When you work on web or UI tasks, Claude first picks relevant design specs, enforces a DESIGN.md design-system file, builds reusable components from your reference image or brand style, then checks performance and visual details in a real browser.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the request involves frontend, UI/UX, or visual work, or mentions keywords like redesign, animation, or React, etc.

say_en.text: Restyle my landing page to look like Stripe.
say_en.note: It extracts the brand spec first, then redesigns.

say_en.text: Add a smooth hover animation to this button.
say_en.note: It looks up the interaction catalog and implements it.

say_en.text: Run a Lighthouse audit on the homepage and suggest fixes.
say_en.note: It audits in a real browser and gives a report.
